. xtset g time

Panel variable: g (strongly balanced)
 Time variable: time, 0 to 8
         Delta: 1 unit

. generate double D=(first_treat>0 & time>=first_treat)

. quietly xtreg y D x1 x2 i.time , fe vce(robust)

. file write wbout "b" _tab %24.17g (_b[D]) _n

. file write wbout "se" _tab %24.17g (_se[D]) _n

. file write wbout "wald_den" _tab %24.17g (r(df_r)) _n
